notes.title: Buccaneers Hideout Update 2
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099670/Pirates_Journey/


The island's secrets continue to be unraveled with each update of Pirates Journey. The location of the gold that pirates hid as a result of plunder was revealed: Buccaneers Hideout

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/15a7bad68a86c3131d3fdf93bd7832e3087cca08.png[/img]

More treasures await you in this heavily guarded hideout than you can find on the entire island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/9b497eb1450109ef90b41abcde5a0eba3f558034.png[/img]

Capturing the hideout is quite difficult and requires a strategy.

It is a dangerous place that must be entered in a planned manner, especially for Co-Op games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/62d957f94de55bad0eb01426b62e03f6cdb33f6e.png[/img]

Update Pirates Journey now and discover this brand new dangerous Buccaneers Hideout!

notes.title: Co-Op Hotfix 1.43
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099670/Pirates_Journey/


[h2]Ahoy Mates![/h2]

A large-scale "Marine Update" is being prepared for Pirates Journey.


Before this, we fixed critical errors encountered in the [b]Co-Op game[/b].


* The bug of the Client not having Inventory at the start of the game in Co-Op games has been fixed.

* The mouse cursor appearing on the Client's screen at the start of the game in Co-Op games has been fixed.

* Fixed the error that occurred when Conner clicked on The Potato Farmer's book in the Co-Op game.

* Co-Op gameplay has been made much smoother. You can also try the Co-Op game and see.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.42
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2099670/Pirates_Journey/

[h3]Ahoy Mates![/h3]

There will be a few hotfixes coming before the next big update. One of them is Hotfix 1.42

* We received notifications from some players that they could not collect the flags of enemy bases when they raided them.

With this update, you can collect flags when you raid enemy pirate bases. Each Enemy base has its own flagpole. The collection option will appear in front of the flagpoles.

* Enemy raids on our pirate camp at regular intervals have been improved.
Instead of raids from a single area, you can now raid from any entrance to your pirate camp.
The Raiders are more diverse now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/8a28aa82b10bd7281da8481ddf909aa5f540606e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/5c002cf8d37c6f67b8c3151e463482acceba1989.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4
notes.notes:
In this new hotfix update;

* Many minor bugs have been resolved.

* Four new Steam Achievements have been added.

[b]Skull Collector:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/d06242055d6ee39d851cfd0aa0471e6de6eff2a8.png[/img]

It unlocks when you collect a total of ten skulls. You can collect skulls from different parts of the island or by killing enemy pirates.

[b]Captain of the five, ten and twenty Crew[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/b0f830ea67c32693e7fb312b301abed4d7d8e589.png[/img]

These three new Steam Achievements are unlocked when you reach 5, 10 and 20 crew members respectively.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.notes:
* Musket Rifle reload issue has been resolved. If you have "Musket Rifle Ammo" in your inventory, you can reload the Musket Rifle with the "R" key.

* First patch update containing some new features will be released soon.
In the upcoming new patch, you will also be able to actively use the renewed Steam Achievements.

Here are a few examples of new Steam Achievements:

notes.title: Thank you for playing Pirates Journey Demo Version
notes.notes:
We made friends with many players who played our game during the Demo Phase and had a great time.

The feedback we received from the demo was very useful for us to develop Pirates Journey.

As 2Medya, we will continue to work intensively on Pirates Journey and will work hard to give you a great pirate experience.

In the meantime, our YouTuber friends will shoot many brand new Pirates Journey videos. You can follow the new versions from the videos.

And finally;

We will announce the Pirates Journey [b]Early Access Release Date[/b] shortly.

notes.title: Pirate Camp Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/16e87c926c01173e38b78172a5e33f964b8c0a95.jpg[/img]

You can settle in a new camping area with your crew and establish your base in this area by building brand new types of structures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/a6630458ff1488985a826bfd1f10ccb2915e03cd.jpg[/img]

You must build new Huts for shelter and fields to feed your growing population.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/c250ce014467e6a927b2bf898b191e65a8e48022.jpg[/img]

We warn you! On the island, rival artificial intelligences united under factions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43430024/aa2bac4c6ada8d01dc32d6d7a80bb0bda2a7a430.jpg[/img]

There are 3 different pirate factions on the island, managed by artificial intelligence other than you. They are stronger now.

We would like to thank our friends who made videos for previous versions. We are excitedly waiting for the videos to be released for this brand new Pirate Camp (0.54) update.

* All our friends who helped with the beta process, please update Pirates Journey to the latest version, 0.54, and start the game from the beginning.
